newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks end down on fears of share oversupply.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks end down on fears of share oversupply.

text.p: Shares lost ground nearly across the board in the afternoon session on Monday as investors stuck close to the sidelines on fears of an oversupply of shares next month, brokers said.
The composite index fell 11.73 points to a provisional close of 780.08. Declining shares swamped advancers 718 to 183.

"The rise in the morning looked like a mere technical rebound," said Kevin Choi, a fund manager at Seoul Investment Trust Co. "Investors are worried because next month there is expected to be 1.2 trillion won additional supply to the market, 450 billion won from IPOs."
